top_signals.title: Europe Gets Hit by Another Energy-Driven Inflation Shock
top_signals.summary: Europe’s latest energy shock is rapidly feeding into consumer prices, with inflation accelerating across some of the euro area’s largest economies and leaving the European Central Bank facing an increasingly uncomfortable policy dilemma. September data show particularly strong increases in southern Europe. Spain’s harmonized inflation rate jumped to 5.0%, up from 4.6% in August and its highest reading in several years. Spain’s statistics agency INE said rising prices for fuels and lubricants were among the main drivers.…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
